author: Puckybara
body:
Depends on what gear you have currently farmed.

If you have mana flask bonus gear then stick with Heretic. If you only have magic bonus gear then choosing either would work.

body: I started with ara. The ara vesta 3 spell is really useful and its easy to hit with a lot of damage using the sigils. Corvus is great for endless.
